data.text: Criterion 8 cannot be met by a release, and the diagnosis that led to it was wrong. npmjs.com reports sourceCommitResponseCode 408 and sourceCommitUnreachable for 0.8.1 too — and for sigstore 5.0.0, @sigstore/sign 5.0.0 and vitest 5.0.3, checked the same minute. It is npm's fetch of the commit from GitHub timing out for everyone (github.com tree pages answered 504 after 11 s for npm/cli and sindresorhus/is as well), not a 408 cached once for kadence. Nothing in package.json, release.yml or the repository causes it; the signed provenance itself is valid. Left unchecked; the warning goes when npm's fetch does.
